test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Football tournament was being avoided by his son.

options.text: His son is avoiding football tournament.
His son was avoiding football tournament.

solution:
The correct answer is **"His son was avoiding football tournament."**
